scope: Current official SEO guidance and focused Google Search Central video research
limitations: No Search Console, analytics, keyword-volume or account-specific field data were accessed.
Thirteen public video metadata/descriptions were inspected; zero videos were watched.
English caption tracks were advertised for thirteen videos; bounded timedtext requests returned HTTP 200 and zero bytes. Zero transcripts were read.
Playlist URLs were recovered from the official announcement but their current contents or membership could not be verified.
Repository observations are not live deployment verification.

sources.title: SEO Starter Guide
sources.finding: Discovery, useful content and accurate search presentation.
sources.application: Preserve real navigation links, concise task-based titles and readable content.

sources.title: Creating helpful, reliable, people-first content
sources.finding: Original utility and truthful who/how/why matter; fabricated author identities are misleading.
sources.application: Keep organization authorship and AI assistance transparent; improve decisions rather than page counts.

sources.title: Spam policies
sources.finding: Scaled low-value content for ranking manipulation is abuse irrespective of how it is generated.
sources.application: Do not index every product pair or rewrite copied feeds into thin articles.

sources.title: JavaScript SEO basics
sources.finding: Crawlable anchors, rendered content and consistent indexing controls are necessary.
sources.application: Test raw HTML and rendered output; retain core facts when optional scripts fail.

sources.title: Managing crawling of faceted navigation URLs
sources.finding: Crawl prevention differs from noindex; canonical hints are less dependable for crawl control.
sources.application: Keep dynamic states bounded and intentionally noindex; do not robots-block URLs that must reveal noindex without reviewing index state.

sources.title: URL canonicalization
sources.finding: Canonical preference is a hint, and duplicate content is not automatically a spam violation.
sources.application: Consolidate true duplicates while preserving real variants.

sources.title: Specifying canonical URLs
sources.finding: Redirects, canonical links and sitemap signals should be consistent.
sources.application: Align preferred-host internal links, exact identities and redirect targets.

sources.title: Product snippet structured data
sources.finding: Name and at least one of offers/review/aggregateRating are required for Product snippets.
sources.application: Do not invent offers or ratings; generic Product specification markup is not automatically snippet eligible.

sources.title: Ecommerce navigation structure
sources.finding: Products should be discoverable through category and product anchors rather than only a search box.
sources.application: Preserve catalog pagination and connect exact-model products to useful guides.

sources.title: Generative AI search optimization
sources.finding: Google does not require llms.txt, special AI schema, special prose or artificial chunking.
sources.application: Prioritize useful original content, technical clarity and truthful measurement.

sources.title: Web Vitals
sources.finding: Assess current Core Web Vitals at the 75th percentile separately by device class.
sources.application: Do not treat byte counts, lab TBT or one run as real-user INP success.

sources.title: Pagination and incremental loading
sources.finding: Use distinct page URLs, self canonicals and crawlable anchor links; Google does not click load-more controls.
sources.application: Retain numbered static catalog pages and test later-page rows.

sources.title: Article structured data
sources.finding: Article has applicable recommended properties rather than required ones; organization authors are supported.
sources.application: Match visible author, dates, headline and representative image.

sources.title: Organization structured data
sources.finding: Add applicable genuine organization details; there are no universally required properties.
sources.application: Use actual brand, URL and logo, with no invented staff/address/credentials.

sources.title: Site names
sources.finding: Homepage WebSite needs name and canonical URL; site names are not tested by Rich Results Test.
sources.application: Preserve one homepage WebSite identity and validate its syntax separately.

sources.title: Video SEO best practices
sources.finding: Video indexing requires an actual eligible watch page; user-triggered loading alone does not expose it.
sources.application: Do not add VideoObject to supplementary external review links.

sources.title: Merchant listing structured data
sources.finding: Merchant listing experiences differ from product snippets and concern purchase-capable pages.
sources.application: Do not present the comparison site as a retailer without real selling capability.

sources.title: Supported structured-data feature gallery
sources.finding: Current supported feature documentation governs eligibility.
sources.application: Validate against current Google support rather than old tutorial examples.

sources.title: Google Search documentation updates
sources.finding: FAQ rich results stopped appearing May 7, 2026.
sources.application: Retain helpful answers but do not promise retired FAQ enhancements.

sources.title: Localized versions
sources.finding: Corresponding regional pages require proper locale annotations and return links.
sources.application: Use CAD/USD clearly; do not create low-value regional copies or infer hreflang from a client selector.

sources.title: Core Web Vitals and Search
sources.finding: Current metrics remain LCP, INP and CLS; good boundaries are approximately 2.5 seconds, 200 ms and 0.1.
sources.application: Defer optional models and data; measure the actual experience under comparable conditions.

sources.title: Discover and your website
sources.finding: Discover eligibility does not guarantee inclusion; representative high-resolution images and large previews help presentation.
sources.application: Keep appropriate 1200-pixel-or-wider editorial images without clickbait.

sources.title: Link best practices
sources.finding: Real href anchors and meaningful contextual text support discovery.
sources.application: Use links for page navigation and buttons for actions.

sources.title: Title links
sources.finding: Titles should be accurate and descriptive; Google may select alternate text.
sources.application: Use task-specific titles without stuffing or automatic current-year suffixes.

sources.title: Snippets
sources.finding: Useful accurate descriptions inform presentation; Google can derive snippets from page text.
sources.application: Avoid generic or misleading descriptions and fixed character-count ranking rules.

sources.title: Search Console performance report
sources.finding: Clicks, impressions, CTR and position are different measures with aggregation and dimension limitations.
sources.application: Measure country/device/query/page changes only with real authorized data.

sources.title: URL Inspection
sources.finding: Indexed snapshots and live tests differ; a live test does not predict canonical selection.
sources.application: Keep actual search observations separate from local/live technical tests.

sources.title: Google Trends data FAQ
sources.finding: Trends uses sampled normalized relative interest rather than absolute monthly search volume.
sources.application: Record locale, time range, terms/topics and search type; never fabricate volume.

sources.title: Build and submit a sitemap
sources.finding: Sitemaps support discovery and should reference intended canonicals; lastmod needs substantive accuracy.
sources.application: Exclude drafts and arbitrary states; do not equate submission with indexing.

sources.title: General structured-data guidelines
sources.finding: Markup must describe visible current truthful content; validity does not guarantee search appearance.
sources.application: Test schema syntax, visible-data parity and eligibility separately.

sources.title: Favicon in search
sources.finding: Favicons are separate from organization logos and social cards, with crawlability and presentation requirements.
sources.application: Check the actual homepage favicon link, stable URL and square asset.

sources.title: Generative AI performance report
sources.finding: The report measures generative Search impressions; documentation states worldwide rollout by August 31, 2026.
sources.application: Do not label impressions as visits or invent account-specific report data.

sources.title: New SEO learning paths announcement
sources.finding: The October 6, 2026 announcement links Search fundamentals and Technical SEO curated playlists.
sources.application: Use focused research with honest playlist and caption-access limits.

sources.title: Google Trends tutorial announcement
sources.finding: The official announcement identifies Trending Now and advanced analysis tutorials.
sources.application: Use relevant trend questions as research leads, not unsupported news claims.
